text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn like humans. Machine learning is a part of AI. It helps computers improve by using data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning. It uses large neural networks to solve difficult problems, such as recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is part of our daily life. We use it in search engines, maps, online shopping, and voice assistants like Siri. AI also helps doctors find diseases and helps companies work faster. AI is changing the world around us.
